q2_gaps: clausal (gerund) complement of a predicative adjective — "ashamed of being born poor": the instruction set does not say whether the complement eventuality is asserted at top level (the emotive-factive presupposition) or sealed as a term; its nearest written analog, a noun's clausal argument PP ("a vehicle for V-ing"), says such an eventuality is "asserted nowhere"
notes: Reified ashamed state + Experiencer + Of oblique + flat (Past (Member sk_man_1 ashamed)) dual-emit, "born" lemmatized to bear with the man as Patient of an agentless birth, and the depictive "poor" as a plain flat state with no Result all follow the spec as written. The birth atoms and the depictive are asserted at top level, which the adjective-complement rule neither licenses nor forbids (see the gap).
